title: Improving Diversity of Demographic Representation in Large Language Models via Collective-Critiques and Self-Voting

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the diversity of representation by calculating the entropy and max-gap of the gender distribution of people entities generated in responses to open-ended, occupation-seeking prompts, using an entity extractor and a Knowledge Graph.
